description: This file contains utility functions and logic for resolving extension directories, test plans, and creating test shards for a suite of plugins/extensions in a project. It imports filesystem and path modules, references various extension-related path checks, and provides functions to discover, analyze, and batch process extension test files.

methods.name: normalizeRelative
methods.description: Converts a given filesystem path to use forward slashes for consistency.

methods.name: countTestFiles
methods.description: Counts the number of test files (ending with .test.ts or .test.tsx) in a directory tree.

methods.name: resolveExtensionDirectory
methods.description: Resolves the directory of an extension given a target argument or current working directory.

methods.name: resolveExtensionTestPlan
methods.description: Generates a test plan for a specific extension, identifying root paths, config files, and test file count.

methods.name: mergeTestPlans
methods.description: Merges multiple test plans into a summarized plan grouped by configuration.

methods.name: resolveExtensionBatchPlan
methods.description: Creates a combined plan for multiple extensions identified by their IDs.

methods.name: pickLeastLoadedShard
methods.description: Selects the shard with the least number of test files and plans for load balancing.

methods.name: createExtensionTestShards
methods.description: Distributes extension test plans into multiple shards (batches) for parallel testing.
